subject: ACE registration & co-sell ops: CloudAxis intake and runbook
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodai.com>
To: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@cloudaxis.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + ACE registration intake (CloudAxis)

Hi Asha,

Thanks for the time last week — CloudAxis looked like a great fit for Redwood's ACE co-sell program based on your workload patterns and target customers. We can move quickly on ACE registration if CloudAxis wants to pursue co-sell with AWS.

Quick asks to get started:
- Can you confirm the prime contact for the AWS intake (name + email)?
- Do you have an existing AWS Partner ID to include on the application?
- Are there any compliance controls (SOC2, HIPAA) or legal constraints we should note up front?

I've attached a short intake template to capture customer names, expected ARR motion, and deployment model — filling that will speed the registration. Once you confirm, I'll introduce our PDM/PSM pair for an intake kickoff and share a lightweight runbook for co-sell orchestration.

Proposed near-term timeline: ACE registration form -> PDM/PSM kickoff -> mutual action plan (MAP) -> co-sell enablement (2–3 weeks typical).

Attachment: redwood_ace_intake_template.xlsx

Thanks — happy to sync live if that's easier.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior GTM Partner Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodai.com

-----
From: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@cloudaxis.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Devon Park <devon.park@cloudaxis.com>, CloudAxis Sales <sales@cloudaxis.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Nov 2027 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + ACE registration intake (CloudAxis)

Hi Naomi — great to hear from you.

CloudAxis is definitely interested in ACE registration and exploring joint GTM on a couple of pilot accounts. Quick answers below and a couple of asks:

- Prime contact: Asha Reddy (asha.reddy@cloudaxis.com) — that's me.
- AWS Partner ID: 9876543210
- Compliance: We are SOC 2 Type II in the US; HIPAA is in scope only for a subset of customers (we have a BA signing process).

Can we target an intake kickoff next Wednesday (24 Nov) between 10–11am PT? Also, could you share the runbook skeleton you mentioned — we want to surface any legal/procurement gates up front.

Looping in Devon (Head of Partnerships) and the sales alias to coordinate timing.

Thanks,
Asha
VP, Strategic Partnerships
CloudAxis
asha.reddy@cloudaxis.com

-----
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodai.com>
To: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@cloudaxis.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodai.com>, CloudAxis Sales <sales@cloudaxis.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Nov 2027 13:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + ACE registration intake (CloudAxis)

Asha — perfect, thanks for the quick reply and the Partner ID. 10–11am PT on 24 Nov works for us.

Karthik and Marissa, I’m looping you in as our PDM/PSM leads for this account — can you do a short intake during the kickoff and own the ACE registration form? High level runbook expectations (attached as a draft):

- Pre-kickoff: Intake template (customer list, deployment type, first pilot account) completed by CloudAxis (asha)
- Kickoff (24 Nov): PDM/PSM technical & GTM sync, map pilot accounts and AWS contacts
- Registration: Complete ACE form + provide SOC 2 evidence link to AWS program team
- MAP: Draft mutual action plan (owner: Redwood partner manager + CloudAxis sales) with milestones and co-sell plays
- Enablement: Joint internal enablement + 1 pilot case study run

Attachment: cloudaxis-ace-runbook-draft.docx

Asha — if there are procurement/legal redlines we should expect, flag them in the intake doc and we’ll route to our legal ops. Karthik/Marissa — can you confirm you have availability for the 24 Nov window and take the lead on the registration?

Thanks all,
Naomi

-----
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Nov 2027 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ACE registration & co-sell ops: CloudAxis intake and runbook

Quick internal note — I pushed a placeholder MAP in HubSpot and shared the link below so we can capture milestones during the kickoff. I’ll own sales-side follow-ups and initial opportunity tagging once the intake is filled.

HubSpot MAP: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567890

If PDM/PSM confirm availability, I’ll block the calendar and send an invite with the MAP link and pre-read.

Thanks,

Redwood Inference
